title: Book Two · Chapter 64: A Book for the Shelf
story:
On Thursday, the borrowing corner has three books on its front table. One is thick, with a gold line on the cover. One is thin, with a little dog. The third has wide pages and pictures of trees.

Ronan goes straight to the thick book. He lifts it with both hands. The gold line catches the light.

“Are you taking that?” Jun asks.

“Maybe.”

Ronan opens the first page. There are many lines and very little space between them. He knows the first few words. Then he cannot understand the next line. He turns a page. That page is harder.

Jun takes the tree book and opens it. A large leaf fills half the page. He reads a short part under it.

“I want this one.”

Ronan keeps the thick book open. He imagines it under his arm on the way home. Mum will see it. Leo will see it tomorrow.

The helper asks for his card.

“I have not chosen yet,” Ronan says.

He closes the thick book. Its cover makes a soft sound on the table. He puts it back carefully and reaches for the thin one.

Before he opens it, he looks at the gold line once more.

Jun has already found another leaf in his tree book. He is following its edge with his finger.

“Are you going to read all of that?” Ronan asks.

“Not in one day.”

Ronan looks at the thick book again. He can carry it home easily. Reading it will be different.

He knows several words in its first line. He tries to put them together in his head. He gets a little way, then loses the person in the story.

The helper waits for his choice. She does not ask him to take the largest book.

Ronan draws the thin one closer. Its little dog has mud on one foot. He did not notice that from the other side of the table.

He puts his thumb near the first page. This time, he wants the words as well as the cover.

He opens the thin book. The dog is under a cart in the first picture. A woman looks for it near a gate. The lines are short. He can read them. But why does the dog stay there? He wants to find out.

“This one,” he says.

The helper checks the card. She puts it in the right box. Ronan waits. Then he takes the book.

Jun is at the doorway. “What happens to the dog?”

“I do not know yet.”

“Maybe it likes carts.”

“Maybe it ate the horse.”

Jun looks at the tiny dog on the cover. “A very small horse.”

They laugh and return to their seats. Leo notices the book after lunch. He asks to see the dog picture. He does not ask why the book is thin.

At home, Ronan reads the whole story. The dog is guarding a small basket under the cart. A kitten sleeps inside. The woman cannot see the basket from the gate.

Ronan goes back to the first picture. One little ear shows above its edge. He missed that before.

He calls Mum over. He covers the later page with his hand.

“Can you find the kitten?”

Mum leans closer. At first she points to the dog's ear. Ronan shakes his head and grins. This time he knows the answer first. He gives her time to find it herself.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cover＝封面；wide＝宽的；space＝空间。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么没有借走最厚的书？
2. 他对自己的选择有什么感觉？

## 读句子

**He / opens / the thin book.** 他／打开／那本薄书。
